name: tpl-chain-response-3-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. If the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires the exit and Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires the box in hand at that moment, which together express 'carry the box to the exit'; ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) hard matches 'pick it up again on your very next move' after a fall, and box_fell is correctly treated only as a condition, not a goal.

texts: At the exit, be holding the box.
If the box falls, be holding it again on the very next step.
